facts.value: Saves other link and priority as u8, unlinks gobj, copies saved placement, and inserts after other->prev_gx as read after removal. For distinct linked objects this moves gobj immediately before other, including when previously adjacent. No distinctness check exists; self-reference reinserts at bucket head because removal clears the same object predecessor.

facts.value: Correct use maintains one GX-list membership per object. Setup and GObj_GXReorder do not detach existing membership, so callers must supply an object safe to insert. Removal repairs head/tail and neighboring pointers then marks the object unlinked. Relocation removes, updates placement, and reinserts. Sorted lists use ascending stored byte priorities; tail-search setup inserts after equals, while head-search setup/relocation inserts before equals.
